Designed for enthusiasts, this keyboard combines premium acoustics, extensive customization, versatile connectivity, and a refined typing experience. Whether you're gaming, working, or creating, every component is engineered to deliver exceptional comfort, reliability, and everyday performance.
Five layers of carefully engineered sound dampening, including premium high-density silicone, reduce unwanted resonance and vibration for a cleaner, deeper typing sound. The dense silicone also adds noticeable weight, giving the keyboard a more solid and premium feel.
A premium FR4 plate provides a balanced typing feel with crisp acoustics and excellent durability. Combined with a dual mount structure that blends the precision of a top mount with the cushioning of a thick gasket, every keystroke feels stable, comfortable, and enthusiast-grade.
Factory pre-lubed Zen switches deliver a smooth, consistent keystroke with a deep and satisfying sound profile. Carefully tuned for a refined typing experience, they provide excellent stability and comfort straight out of the box without requiring additional modifications.
Choose from over 50 built-in RGB lighting effects to personalize your setup with vibrant colors and dynamic animations. Equipped with north-facing LEDs, the keyboard delivers brighter illumination and excellent compatibility with a wide range of keycap profiles. Easily customize brightness, speed, and effects to match your style.
Switch seamlessly between 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired USB Type-C to suit any workflow. With full support for Windows, macOS, and Linux, the keyboard offers reliable connectivity across desktops, laptops, and multiple devices.
Powered by open source firmware based on QMK with full VIA and VIAL compatibility, the keyboard offers complete control over key remapping, macros, layers and all advanced QMK features. SignalRGB and OpenRGB support allow seamless RGB synchronization with compatible devices for a unified lighting experience.
A premium custom Type A to Type-C cable is included, featuring a thick rubber construction and precision metal connectors for a refined look and feel. Inspired by enthusiast custom cables, it complements the keyboard while providing a durable and reliable connection.
Everything you need is included right out of the box. The CORE 75 comes complete with the keyboard, custom thick cable with metal connectors, dust cover, extra switches, keycap/switch puller, and user manual — giving you all essential accessories for setup, customization, and maintenance.

<script>
  if (typeof CustomMegaMenu === 'undefined') {
    class CustomMegaMenu {
      constructor() {
        this.container = document.getElementById('MegaMenuDrawer');
        if (!this.container || this.container.classList.contains('js-initialized')) return;

        this.triggers = document.querySelectorAll('a[data-megamenu-trigger]');
        this.mainPanels = this.container.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__panel');
        this.subPanels = this.container.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__sub-panel');
        this.linksWithChildren = this.container.querySelectorAll('a.mega-menu__link.has-children');

        this.triggers.forEach(trigger => trigger.addEventListener('click', this.openMegaMenu.bind(this)));
        this.container.querySelector('.mega-menu__close-button').addEventListener('click', this.closeMegaMenu.bind(this));
        this.container.querySelector('.mega-menu__overlay').addEventListener('click', this.closeMegaMenu.bind(this));
        this.linksWithChildren.forEach(link => link.addEventListener('click', this.openSubPanel.bind(this)));
        this.container.classList.add('js-initialized');
      }

      openMegaMenu(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const handle = event.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-megamenu-trigger');
        const targetPanel = this.container.querySelector(`.mega-menu__panel[data-handle="${handle}"]`);
        if (!targetPanel) return;

        this.subPanels.forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('is-active'));
        this.linksWithChildren.forEach(link => link.classList.remove('is-active'));

        this.mainPanels.forEach(panel => panel.style.display = 'none');
        targetPanel.style.display = 'flex';

        this.triggers.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('is-active'));
        event.currentTarget.classList.add('is-active');

        this.container.style.visibility = 'visible';
        this.container.classList.add('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      }

      closeMegaMenu() {
        this.container.classList.remove('is-open');
        document.body.style.overflow = '';
        this.triggers.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('is-active'));
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!this.container.classList.contains('is-open')) {
            this.container.style.visibility = 'hidden';
          }
        }, 400);
      }
      
      openSubPanel(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const targetPanelId = event.currentTarget.getAttribute('data-target-panel');
        const targetPanel = this.container.querySelector(`#${targetPanelId}`);
        if (!targetPanel) return;

        // **FIX:** Check if the clicked item is already active
        const isAlreadyActive = event.currentTarget.classList.contains('is-active');

        // First, clear all existing active states
        const parentList = event.currentTarget.closest('.mega-menu__list');
        parentList.querySelectorAll('.mega-menu__link').forEach(link => link.classList.remove('is-active'));
        this.subPanels.forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('is-active'));

        // If it wasn't already active, make it active now. If it was, it remains closed.
        if (!isAlreadyActive) {
          event.currentTarget.classList.add('is-active');
          targetPanel.classList.add('is-active');
        }
      }
    }
    new CustomMegaMenu();
  }
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    console.log('[Gallery Debug] DOMContentLoaded event fired.'); // DEBUG LOG

    const galleryContainer = document.getElementById('product-gallery-template--20157508288751__main');
    const mainSplideEl = document.getElementById('main-splide-template--20157508288751__main');
    const thumbnailsSplideEl = document.getElementById('thumbnails-splide-template--20157508288751__main');

    if (!mainSplideEl) {
      console.error('[Gallery Debug] Main Splide element not found. Exiting.'); // DEBUG LOG
      return;
    }

    if (typeof Splide === 'undefined') {
      console.error('[Splide Gallery] Error: Splide library is not loaded.');
      if (galleryContainer) { galleryContainer.style.visibility = 'visible'; galleryContainer.style.opacity = '1'; }
      return;
    }

    try {
      // ... (The Splide initialization part remains the same)
      const mainSplide = new Splide(mainSplideEl, { type: 'fade', rewind: true, pagination: true, arrows: false, lazyLoad: 'nearby' });
      let thumbnailsSplide = null;
      mainSplideEl.splideInstance = mainSplide;

      if (thumbnailsSplideEl) {
        thumbnailsSplide = new Splide(thumbnailsSplideEl, { fixedWidth: 100, fixedHeight: 100, gap: 10, rewind: true, pagination: false, isNavigation: true, arrows: false, focus: 'center', lazyLoad: 'nearby' });
        mainSplide.sync(thumbnailsSplide);
        thumbnailsSplideEl.splideInstance = thumbnailsSplide;
      }

      function updatePagination(splide) { if (!splide.options.pagination || splide.Components.Pagination.items.length <= 5) { return; } const activeIndex = splide.index; const dots = splide.Components.Pagination.items; const window = 2; dots.forEach((dot) => { const pageIndex = dot.page; if (pageIndex >= activeIndex - window && pageIndex <= activeIndex + window) { dot.li.style.display = ''; } else { dot.li.style.display = 'none'; } }); }

      mainSplide.on('mounted', () => {
        console.log('[Gallery Debug] Main Splide mounted.'); // DEBUG LOG
        galleryContainer.classList.add('is-splide-initialized');
      });
      mainSplide.on('pagination:updated', (data, splide) => updatePagination(mainSplide));
      mainSplide.on('moved', () => updatePagination(mainSplide));

      mainSplide.mount();
      if (thumbnailsSplide) { thumbnailsSplide.mount(); }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[Splide Gallery] Error during initialization.", e);
      if (galleryContainer) { galleryContainer.style.visibility = 'visible'; galleryContainer.style.opacity = '1'; }
    }

    const triggerButton = document.getElementById('view-in-3d-trigger-template--20157508288751__main');
    const modal = document.getElementById('view-in-3d-modal-template--20157508288751__main');
    if (triggerButton && modal) {
      const closeButton = modal.querySelector('.view-in-3d-modal__close-button');
      const overlay = modal.querySelector('.view-in-3d-modal__overlay');
      const openModal = () => { modal.classList.add('is-active'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; };
      const closeModal = () => { modal.classList.remove('is-active'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; };
      triggerButton.addEventListener('click', openModal);
      closeButton.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      overlay.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => { if (event.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('is-active')) { closeModal(); } });
    }
    
    let allOriginalMainSlides = [], allOriginalThumbSlides = [], allOriginalModalSlides = [];

    function initializeSlideStorage() {
      // ... (This function is fine, no logs needed here unless it fails)
      const mainSlidesList = galleryContainer.querySelector('#main-splide-template--20157508288751__main .splide__list');
      const thumbSlidesList = galleryContainer.querySelector('#thumbnails-splide-template--20157508288751__main .splide__list');
      const modalSlidesList = galleryContainer.querySelector('#modal-splide-template--20157508288751__main .splide__list');
      if (!allOriginalMainSlides.length && mainSlidesList) { allOriginalMainSlides = Array.from(mainSlidesList.children).map(slide => slide.cloneNode(true)); }
      if (!allOriginalThumbSlides.length && thumbSlidesList) { allOriginalThumbSlides = Array.from(thumbSlidesList.children).map(slide => slide.cloneNode(true)); }
      if (!allOriginalModalSlides.length && modalSlidesList) { allOriginalModalSlides = Array.from(modalSlidesList.children).map(slide => slide.cloneNode(true)); }
    }

    function updateVariantImages(variant) {
      console.log('[Gallery Debug] updateVariantImages() called with variant:', variant); // DEBUG LOG
      if (!variant || !variant.options) {
        console.warn('[Gallery Debug] updateVariantImages() received an invalid variant. Aborting.'); // DEBUG LOG
        return;
      }
      const variantValues = variant.options;
      console.log('[Gallery Debug] Filtering for variant options:', variantValues); // DEBUG LOG

      if (galleryContainer && galleryContainer.hasAttribute('image-grouping-enabled')) {
        initializeSlideStorage();
        const mainSlidesList = galleryContainer.querySelector('#main-splide-template--20157508288751__main .splide__list');
        if (!mainSlidesList) return;
        
        const matchingMainSlides = [];
        allOriginalMainSlides.forEach((slide) => {
          const slideGroup = slide.dataset.imageGroup;
          const isMatching = variantValues.some(value => value && value.toLowerCase().trim() === slideGroup);
          if (isMatching) {
            matchingMainSlides.push(slide.cloneNode(true));
          }
        });
        
        console.log(`[Gallery Debug] Found ${matchingMainSlides.length} matching images out of ${allOriginalMainSlides.length}.`); // DEBUG LOG
        
        // ... (The rest of the function remains the same)
        const thumbSlidesList = galleryContainer.querySelector('#thumbnails-splide-template--20157508288751__main .splide__list');
        const modalSlidesList = galleryContainer.querySelector('#modal-splide-template--20157508288751__main .splide__list');
        const matchingThumbSlides = [], matchingModalSlides = [];
        allOriginalMainSlides.forEach((slide, index) => {
          const slideGroup = slide.dataset.imageGroup;
          const isMatching = variantValues.some(value => value && value.toLowerCase().trim() === slideGroup);
          if (isMatching) {
            if (allOriginalThumbSlides[index]) matchingThumbSlides.push(allOriginalThumbSlides[index].cloneNode(true));
            if (allOriginalModalSlides[index]) matchingModalSlides.push(allOriginalModalSlides[index].cloneNode(true));
          }
        });
        const repopulateSlides = (listEl, slides, originalSlides) => { if (!listEl) return; listEl.innerHTML = ''; const slidesToRender = slides.length > 0 ? slides : originalSlides; slidesToRender.forEach(slide => listEl.appendChild(slide.cloneNode(true))); };
        repopulateSlides(mainSlidesList, matchingMainSlides, allOriginalMainSlides);
        repopulateSlides(thumbSlidesList, matchingThumbSlides, allOriginalThumbSlides);
        repopulateSlides(modalSlidesList, matchingModalSlides, allOriginalModalSlides);
        
        setTimeout(() => {
          const mainSplide = document.getElementById('main-splide-template--20157508288751__main')?.splideInstance;
          const thumbnailsSplide = document.getElementById('thumbnails-splide-template--20157508288751__main')?.splideInstance;
          const modalSplide = document.getElementById('modal-splide-template--20157508288751__main')?.splideInstance;
          if (mainSplide) { mainSplide.refresh(); mainSplide.go(0); }
          if (thumbnailsSplide) thumbnailsSplide.refresh();
          if (modalSplide) modalSplide.refresh();
        }, 100);
      }
    }
    
    if (typeof subscribe === 'function' && typeof PUB_SUB_EVENTS !== 'undefined') {
      subscribe(PUB_SUB_EVENTS.variantChange, (event) => { if (event.data && event.data.variant && event.data.sectionId === 'template--20157508288751__main') { updateVariantImages(event.data.variant); } });
    } else {
      document.addEventListener('change', function(event) { if (event.target.matches('input[name="id"]')) { const variantId = event.target.value; const productJson = document.querySelector('[data-product-json]'); if (productJson && variantId) { try { const product = JSON.parse(productJson.textContent); const selectedVariant = product.variants.find(v => v.id == variantId); if (selectedVariant) updateVariantImages(selectedVariant); } catch (e) { console.error('Error parsing product JSON:', e); } } } });
    }
    
    function getVariantById(variantId) { /* ... same as before ... */ }

    function getInitialVariant() {
  // Priority 1: The Selected Variant JSON Script
  // This is the correct method for your theme's HTML structure.
  const selectedVariantScript = document.querySelector('script[data-selected-variant]');

  if (selectedVariantScript && selectedVariantScript.textContent) {
    try {
      // We parse the text inside the script tag to get the variant object.
      const variantObject = JSON.parse(selectedVariantScript.textContent);
      return variantObject;
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[Gallery] Error parsing selected variant JSON.', e);
      // If parsing fails, we continue to the fallback.
    }
  }

  // Priority 2: The Last Resort Fallback (if the script tag is empty)
  const productJsonEl = document.querySelector('[data-product-json]');
  if (productJsonEl) {
    try {
      const product = JSON.parse(productJsonEl.textContent);
      return product.variants[0] || null;
    } catch (e) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  // If all methods fail, return null.
  return null;
}
    
    console.log('[Gallery Debug] Setting up initial variant check with 200ms delay.'); // DEBUG LOG
    setTimeout(() => {
      console.log('[Gallery Debug] setTimeout fired. Calling getInitialVariant().'); // DEBUG LOG
      const initialVariant = getInitialVariant();
      if (initialVariant) {
        updateVariantImages(initialVariant);
      } else {
        console.error('[Gallery Debug] setTimeout fired, but getInitialVariant() returned null.'); // DEBUG LOG
      }
    }, 200);
    
    window.updateVariantGallery = updateVariantImages;
  });
</script>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    // Check if Splide is defined
    if (typeof Splide === 'undefined') {
      console.error('Splide.js is not loaded. Please ensure it is included in your theme.');
      return;
    }

    const switchSliders = document.querySelectorAll('.switch-slider');
    if (switchSliders.length > 0) {
      // --- Splide Carousel Initialization ---
      const splide = new Splide('.switch-slider', {
        perPage: 3,
        gap: '1.5rem',
        pagination: true,
        arrows: false,
        breakpoints: {
          1024: {
            perPage: 2,
          },
          768: {
            perPage: 1,
          },
        },
      });
      splide.mount();

      // --- Audio Player Logic ---
      const audioButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.switch-card__sound-btn');
      let currentlyPlaying = null;

      audioButtons.forEach(button => {
        const audioId = button.dataset.audioId;
        const audio = document.getElementById(audioId);

        if (audio) {
          button.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (currentlyPlaying && currentlyPlaying !== audio) {
              currentlyPlaying.pause();
            }
            
            if (audio.paused) {
              audio.play();
            } else {
              audio.pause();
            }
          });

          audio.onplay = () => {
            currentlyPlaying = audio;
            document.querySelectorAll('.switch-card__sound-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('is-playing'));
            button.classList.add('is-playing');
          };

          audio.onpause = () => {
            if (currentlyPlaying === audio) {
              currentlyPlaying = null;
            }
            button.classList.remove('is-playing');
          };
          
           audio.onended = () => {
            currentlyPlaying = null;
            button.classList.remove('is-playing');
          };
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>

<script>
  if (!window.customSearchDrawerInitialized) {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      const searchDrawer = document.getElementById('CustomSearchDrawer');
      if (!searchDrawer) return;

      const openTrigger = document.getElementById('CustomSearchDrawerTrigger');
      const closeTrigger = document.getElementById('CustomSearchDrawerClose');
      const overlay = document.getElementById('CustomSearchOverlay');
      const searchInput = document.getElementById('Search-In-Drawer');
      const initialStateContainer = document.getElementById('DrawerInitialState');
      const resetButton = searchDrawer.querySelector('button[type="reset"]');

      const updateViewState = () => {
        const isInputEmpty = searchInput.value.trim() === '';
        initialStateContainer.classList.toggle('hidden', !isInputEmpty);
      };

      const openDrawer = () => {
        searchDrawer.classList.add('is-open');
        setTimeout(() => searchInput.focus(), 300);
      };

      const closeDrawer = () => searchDrawer.classList.remove('is-open');
      
      if (openTrigger) openTrigger.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
      if (closeTrigger) closeTrigger.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
      if (overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);
      if (searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('input', updateViewState);
      
      if (resetButton) resetButton.addEventListener('click', () => {
        setTimeout(updateViewState, 50);
      });

      // --- NEW: Typewriter Placeholder Animation ---
      const phrasesToAnimate = [
        'keyboards',
        'gaming mouse',
        'monitors',
        'headsets'
      ];
      const baseText = 'Search for ';
      let phraseIndex = 0;
      let charIndex = 0;
      let isDeleting = false;
      let animationFrameId;

      function typewriterEffect() {
        if (searchInput.value.trim() !== '') {
          // Stop animation if user is typing
          searchInput.setAttribute('placeholder', 'Search for...'); // Reset to default
          return;
        }

        const currentPhrase = phrasesToAnimate[phraseIndex];
        let displayText = '';

        if (isDeleting) {
          displayText = baseText + currentPhrase.substring(0, charIndex - 1);
          charIndex--;
        } else {
          displayText = baseText + currentPhrase.substring(0, charIndex + 1);
          charIndex++;
        }

        searchInput.setAttribute('placeholder', displayText);

        let time = isDeleting ? 80 : 150;

        if (!isDeleting && charIndex === currentPhrase.length) {
          time = 2000; // Pause after typing a phrase
          isDeleting = true;
        } else if (isDeleting && charIndex === 0) {
          isDeleting = false;
          phraseIndex = (phraseIndex + 1) % phrasesToAnimate.length;
          time = 500; // Pause before typing next phrase
        }
        
        animationFrameId = setTimeout(typewriterEffect, time);
      }

      // Start the animation when the drawer opens
      openTrigger.addEventListener('click', () => {
        clearTimeout(animationFrameId);
        typewriterEffect();
      });

      // Stop the animation if the user starts typing
      searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
        clearTimeout(animationFrameId);
        if (searchInput.value.trim() === '') {
          // If they clear the input, restart the animation
          typewriterEffect();
        }
      });
    });
    window.customSearchDrawerInitialized = true;
  }
</script>

<style>
  :root {

  .help-drawer__close-button {

    align-items: center;

</style>

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const drawerId = 'HelpDrawer';
    const drawer = document.getElementById(drawerId);
    if (!drawer) return;

    const openDrawer = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      drawer.classList.add('is-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    };

    const closeDrawer = () => {
      drawer.classList.remove('is-open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };

    // Use event delegation for triggers
    document.body.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (e.target.closest(`[data-drawer-trigger="${drawerId}"]`)) {
        openDrawer(e);
      }
      if (e.target.closest('[data-drawer-close]')) {
        closeDrawer();
      }
    });

    // Close with escape key
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && drawer.classList.contains('is-open')) {
        closeDrawer();
      }
    });
  });
</script>
